'''''Dimorphotheca spectabilis''''' is a plant that belongs to the genus ''[[Dimorphotheca]]''.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=3320-37|title=Dimorphotheca spectabilis Schltr.|last1=Foden|first1=W.|last2=Potter|first2=L.|journal=National Assessment: Red List of South African Plants version|date=2005|access-date=7 September 2024}}</ref> The species is endemic to [[KwaZulu-Natal]] Province of South Africa.<ref name = powo/>
